name: Parallel Coordinates based Transfer Function Design
aliases: Parallel Coordinates Based Transfer Function (PCbTF) Design
Parallel Coordinates Based Transfer Function Design
definition: A method for designing high-dimensional transfer functions using parallel coordinates (PC) visualizations, where hypersurfaces are preserved as polyline patterns, allowing easy identification and modification of parameter correlations.
summary: Parallel Coordinates based Transfer Function Design visualizes high-dimensional data as polylines to simplify multi-dimensional transfer function creation by revealing parameter correlations and enabling interactive or automatic classification.
